body.x: Samsung(www.samsung.com) introduced latest products at 'Press Conference' of the CES 2014, the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

There are many latest products, such as the World's Largest 'Curved UHD TV', with a 105-inch screen and a truly cinematic 21:9 aspect ratio with 11 million pixels for a 5,120×2,160 screen resolution, and Samsung 'U9000 Series Curved UHD TVs' - the World's First Curved UHD TV, which is completed by 65-inch and 55-inch Curved TVs, all with an elegant minimal base and ultra slim bezels.

Also, a new range of washing machines and washer dryers helps lighten households' workloads by offering the largest capacity on the market - 5.6 cubic feet (or about 25kg). Samsung is demonstrating its new 'Smart Home service', an integrated platform for appliances and devices that enables consumers to control their home with a single app - from the lights and air conditioning to kitchen appliances and security systems.

The new 'Chef Collection' of home appliances combines Samsung technology and beautiful design with the kitchen know-how and passion for food of the Michelin-starred team in Samsung's Club des Chefs. The Samsung's 12.2-inch 'Galaxy NotePRO' and 'TabPRO tablets' present mobile users with an industry-leading WQXGA display, offering crystal clear resolution with more than 4 million pixels, for a best-in-class tablet experience for both content consumption and powerful productivity.

All Galaxy NotePRO and TabPRO tablets are running the most recent version of Android 4.4.The 'NX30' interchangeable-lens camera has an advanced 20.3 MP APS-C CMOS Sensor, Tiltable Electronic Viewfinder (EVF) and exceptionally fast 1/8000 sec Shutter Speed and 9 FPS continuous shooting capability, to create high quality images with faster than ever performance.

The NX30 features NFC and Wi-Fi capabilities, including the 'Tag & Go' function, that lets users tap to share memories instantly and easily when paired with NFC enabled mobile devices. Furthermore, the Galaxy Camera 2 captures images quickly and beautifully with revolutionary technology for instant sharing capabilities, thanks to its 16.3 effective megapixel BSI CMOS sensor, 21x optical zoom lens, 1.6GHz Quad Core processor and the Android platform.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
